## History

God is mentioned during Anne's initial arrival at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the child has never been taught to pray, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to invent a prayer addressed to God. During her first trip to Sunday school alone, [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns more about God and listens to the minister's sermon. Later, after saving [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from croup, [Anne](../character/anne.md) expresses gratitude to God for giving her the practical knowledge she needed to cure the baby.
